title: Online Reiki Healing Courses from Bali
metaDescription: Online Reiki Healing Courses with live classes and high-quality videos. Become a certified Reiki healer with top-leading yoga school in Bali.
intro: Explore Reiki with our online courses at Bali Yoga School. We offer both certified and uncertified Reiki healing courses. Our certified courses are recognized by the Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society in India, with structured learning through live sessions led by experienced instructors.

Regardless of whether you choose a certified or uncertified course, you will gain one-month membership access to all course videos after completion. Each course features high-quality, pre-recorded videos on a range of Reiki healing techniques and theories.
